title: sandbox input
description: One action in the live sandbox: the real contract core and buyer scan compiled to wasm. Actors: alice (seller, owns the agent at the start), bob (buyer), dave (investor), customers. Any order; the contract decides.

action.description: reset/view; payments: pay_customer (a stranger pays 25), pay_verified (with a NEAR AI signature), pay_self (the owner pays 200), pay_sub (from bot.<owner>), pay_fresh (the seller pays 200 from a wallet nothing links to them); seller tricks: plant_key (hidden full-access key), remove_key, toggle_upgrade (an upgrade method), hidden_key (run the agent with the hidden key), hidden_redeploy (take it back with the hidden key); sale: list (alice), cancel, scan (bob), buy (bob); after a sale, alice tries: withdraw, relist, set_key, old_key; wait (days pass, the earn-out closes); shares: offer_share (alice, 20% for 500), buy_share (dave), claim_share, end_share

pay_from_revenue.description: list: hold the whole price; the seller is paid only by customer payments after the sale

skip_scan.description: buy: send the buy without a clean scan (the real SDK and MCP buy_agent never do)
